title: How do I create a guest list?
intent: This article explains how to create a guest list for inviting participants to a survey.
short_answer: To create a guest list, navigate to the Participants page and click 'Create new guest list'. Choose the type: Contact list (from address book), EU list (EU Login users), or Token list (generated unique codes). Name the list, add members, and save.
prerequisites: For contact lists: contacts must exist in the address book
procedure: Choose the guest list type: Contact list, EU list, or Token list.
Enter a name for the guest list.
Add participants: select contacts from address book, search for EU Login users, or specify token count.
For token lists, specify the number of tokens to generate.
The list is created and available for sending invitations.
important_conditions: Three types of guest lists: Contact list, EU list, Token list.
Contact lists use contacts from your address book.
EU lists use EU Login accounts (LDAP lookup).
Token lists generate unique access codes.
Maximum 1 million tokens per guest list.
Guest lists can be activated or deactivated.
Multiple guest lists can exist per survey.
The guest list name must be provided.
troubleshooting: 'You have to provide a name for the new guest list': Enter a name before saving.
'You exceeded the limit of 1 million tokens per guestlist': Reduce the number of tokens.
